column1: # Ray aim baseline — THIS FILE IS AN INPUT TO A TEST, NOT A REPORT.
# How many of its aim points each part answers, recorded on purpose. The scene
# integrity gate fails a part that answers no aim at all, or that answers fewer
# than 75% of the aims it answers here, or that is not listed here at all.
# Do not regenerate this to make a red run go green. A drop is either a scene
# regression to fix, or a deliberate change to the benches whose new numbers a
# person has looked at and accepted. Rewrite it only from the menu item named
# in the line below, and say why in the commit message.
